'''Buñuelos''' are a type of Latin-American fried [[Cookbook:Pastry|pastry]].

==Ingredients==
*5 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
*2 cups [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 cup white sugar 
*1 teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*1 cup vegetable oil for frying

==Procedure==
#In a large bowl combine eggs with ¼ cup sugar, and [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] until thick and lemon-colored. Add the oil. 
#Combine 1 ½ cups of the flour, the baking powder, and the salt. Gradually add this to the egg mixture and beat well.
#Turn dough out onto a floured board (use remaining ½ cup flour) and [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] thoroughly until dough is smooth. 
#Shape dough into 16 balls. [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] each one into a circle about 5 [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] (13 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) in diameter. Let stand uncovered on waxed paper for about 10 minutes. 
#Heat oil in a deep [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] to 350°F (175°C). [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] dough circles until golden brown, turning once. Drain on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]]. 
#Combine the cinnamon and 1 cup sugar. Sprinkle fried dough with sugar/cinnamon mixture. Store in an airtight container.
